vetSays.line: 🛡️ the person in their 50s, Sandra, Deborah and Tariq met them at the door — 4 put down. the person in their 50s, Sandra, Deborah, Tariq are hurt.
🛡️ Pamela, Paloma, Deborah, Zoltan and Sari met them at the door — 5 put down. Paloma, Deborah, Zoltan, Sari are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Tariq just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Sari just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Pamela, Miroslava, Deborah, Tariq and Sari met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 barely walked away. Pamela, Miroslava, Deborah, Tariq, Sari are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Elena just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Sari just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Wanjiru just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Deborah, Zoltan, Sari and Wanjiru met them at the door — 4 put down. Deborah, Zoltan, Sari are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Wanjiru just put down The Loud Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
★ IDENTIFIED: European Elder. Elder. Big shrub; flat white flower plates in June, drooping black berry clusters in late summer. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
📚 Village knowledge: Elif taught everyone about European Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
Elif is showing everyone European Elder by the fire. "See the leaves? Like that. Don't mix it up." The Codex grows — the human way.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: European Elder — named and noted.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Devon just put down Loud-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Elif just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Elif just put down The Big Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Aroha just put down The Suburb... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
🛡️ Elif and Aroha met them at the door — 2 put down. Elif is hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Wanjiru just put down The Audit... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.

regDeaths.name: the absence of sound, shaped like wings
two knobs on glass-still water, watching
a moth the size of a dinner plate, catching light wrong
a crow that watches too long and blinks too little
a gold flash in the grass, gone when you look
a drumbeat with no drummer, getting closer
